title: Prod pulse — desk log
content:
Date: 2024-09-09 to 2024-09-12
Owner: Anika Rao (pm) — running sprint-level launch prep for hosted-models-v2

Morning goals (quick):
- Lock final PRD edits for SLA / rollback behavior (target: EOD 9/12)
- Confirm infra can support 2x burst during 1st week of rollout (ask SRE for stress window)
- Prep canary checklist and smoke test script for Eng handoff

PRD edit notes (short, actionable):
- Scope tweak: remove hard guarantee on 20ms p50 for >1k tokens — replace with latency SLO bands (p50/p95) by model-size. Rationale: kernel perf variance across GPU families.
- Add explicit fallback policy: when dedicated pool saturated -> route to compatible lower-cost variant with token-budget cap + warning header.
- Metrics section: add per-route unit-cost, token-count, infra-cost-estimate (sampled from last 30 days).
- Acceptance criteria: canary must keep error-rate <1% and token-cost delta <15% vs baseline for 24h.

Open questions to resolve (blocking / must-triage):
1) Mateo / runtime: can we set automatic fallback to quantized-variant without changing API surface? (Implication: KV cache compatibility).
2) Priya / infra: what’s realistic sustained burst they can guarantee during launch week? Need quota numbers + timeline for extra reserved capacity.
3) Legal: do we need an opt-in for customer-managed keys when offering private-deployments as a migration path? Who owns the crypto docs?

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick calendar log):
- 09/10 10:30am — Sync with Mateo (runtime) — agenda: fallback flow, KV invalidation edgecases, PR #418 review
- 09/10 2:00pm — Design critique with Elena — UX for "degraded mode" banner + client error codes
- 09/11 9:00am — Infra sync w/ Priya — reserve capacity numbers + autoscale knobs
- 09/12 4:00pm — Pre-launch ops dry run (eng + SRE + SE)

Launch preflight checklist (canary -> grad rollout):
- [ ] Canary build deployed to dedicated pool A (version pinned)
- [ ] Canary traffic rules: 2% global, gradual to 10% if stable for 4h
- [ ] Smoke tests: simple riff generator, long-seq stress (2k tokens), embedding correctness sanity check
- [ ] Observability: per-route p50/p95, token cost, error rates, KV cache hit ratio, model-fallback events
- [ ] Alerting: error-rate >1% (pager), cost spike >30% (email + slack #oncall)
- [ ] Fallback path validated (failover to q8 or smaller model) and rollback button visible in console

Notes from quick runtime review (Mateo):
- KV cache invalidation: risk when switching between model variants; suggested: prefix-namespace + migration TTL of 6h.
- Continuous batching: add telemetry flag to limit max-batch-size under canary to reduce tail latency variance.

Mini personal todo (today):
- Finish PRD section: metrics and acceptance criteria (complete)
- Draft customer-facing one-pager for sales (outline done)
- Email legal re: KMS opt-in samples (send before EOD)
- Prepare checklist doc for ops (template -> share link)

Quick friction/risks (capture):
- Quantized fallback might produce slightly different tokenization outputs -> need eval-set safety check (Elena to run small eval)
- Console UX for rollback not discoverable -> add prominent secondary CTA in rollout modal
- Pricing delta with fallback could confuse customers -> include explicit "cost-aware routing" note in billing docs

Snippet: suggested Slack pings to unblock fast
- @mateo "quick q: can fallback be transparent to API? prefer no change to client tokens header. TLDR: need KV compatibility plan. Available 10:30?"
- @priya "Can infra reserve extra NVMe-backed cache for canary? Need numbers by EOD tomorrow."

References & files to attach to final PRD:
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/418 (perf fixes + fallback wiring)
- Jira: JIRA-HOST-421 (hosted-api rollout epic), JIRA-INFRA-879 (capacity + autoscale)
- Confluence draft: confluence.redwood/PRD/hosted-models-v2 (diagram + acceptance criteria)

End-of-day quick reflection (9/12):
- Progress: PRD edits mostly done; runtime flagged KV migration risk (action: add TTL + safety eval)
- Blockers: capacity confirmation pending from infra (Priya) -> flagged for 9/11 sync
- Next: finalize canary script, prep runbook for first 48h, circulate to SEs + support for first-responder training
